title: Keepsake
paragraphs: “It’s dangerous outside. I want you to stay hidden here until I come back… Fohl, was it? Protect your sister… no matter what.”
“Y-Yeah!”

After sealing the door to the room where the Hakuko siblings were with a strong ice spell, Trash left the tower and headed for the warehouse. Relying on what the Queen had told him about weapon enhancement methods, he implemented what he could, and at the same time, used his skills and magic to take down the soldiers of the Three Heroes Church within the castle. It was then that Trash encountered the Queen.
“I truly appreciate your efforts in disposing of those who tried to oust me… Wise King of Wisdom.”
“Ah, it was only natural… But is there no punishment for me leaving the tower?”
To Trash’s question, the Queen shook her head with a gentle smile.
“Why now? I have always been thinking of the country. Wise King of Wisdom, may I assume you now understand what must be done?”
“…Indeed. I was blind. I had no intention of understanding the heroes or seeking reconciliation. But… I have remembered what must be done. I will go.”

Then, Trash entrusted the situation to the Queen, took down the soldiers trying to open the gate, and climbed atop the castle gate. There, in the plaza, he locked eyes with the pope, who stood confidently, holding a replica weapon, convinced that the revolution was about to succeed.
“Magic Prism X.”
Trash threw a large, cut gemstone-like object into the sky before the battle began. I’ve seen it before—it’s a dazzlingly beautiful gem that sparkles in seven colors.
“Drypha Shine Ray X!”

Trash then fired a high-density beam of light magic at the prism. The magic struck the prism in the air above the plaza. Trash’s magic was absorbed into the prism… and immediately scattered, reflecting in all directions. It flew toward every individual within visual range in the plaza and the capital of Melromarc who had declared allegiance to the Queen’s ousting.

The pope tried to counter with the replica weapon against the unexpectedly powerful attack, but it was too late. The replica weapon was instantly destroyed, and he was pierced by the magic, dying on the spot. It was around that moment that we arrived.
Judging by Trash’s tone, did he expect us to arrive a little earlier?
“Leave the aftermath to me. Now that we have the justification to crush the heretics, there’s no need to trouble the heroes with this matter.”
“That’s fine then…”
“The suppression of the Three Heroes Church will soon be complete. Thanks to the Wise King of Wisdom… and ultimately, the Four Holy Heroes who put an end to this incident.”

Thus, the Three Heroes Church’s evil deeds were exposed—illegal research, selfish actions, and attempts to incite meaningless wars despite the world being on the brink of destruction. That alone, the fact that they had stood against the Wise King of Wisdom, was enough to destroy them. Moreover, seeing the damage caused by the Waves firsthand, the people of the kingdom also understood the situation, which was the final blow. The Queen had already taken measures to ensure that no remnants of the Three Heroes Church would rise again. If everything went smoothly, it was as good as saying the Three Heroes Church had been crushed completely. With that, the problem of the Three Heroes Church was resolved, and it seemed that Trash had begun to act for world peace. Well, it was quite memorable how, during the audience the following day, Trash exchanged glares with us while spitting out words that showed he had resigned himself to his duty as a hero.
“I haven’t reconciled with you! I’m doing this for the world, for Mirelia, and for Lucia!”
“As long as you don’t harm us, we have no complaints.”
“…Hmph! I’ll only thank you for letting me meet Lucia’s precious daughter. But… don’t misunderstand.”
As he said that and walked away, Trash’s back strangely looked larger than before… After giving a brief glare at Father, he walked away without doing anything else.
“He really doesn’t intend to reconcile or apologize. But… he doesn’t seem to want to fight us either.”
“Just like he said.”
“Is that really okay?”
When Itsuki voiced his concern, the Queen answered with a gentle smile.
“If Iwatani-dono allows it, I would like to give him a chance.”
“You’re right. If the legendary weapon that never responded before is now lending him its power, it might be worth trusting him.”
“Thank you. That look in his eyes, his pace, and the way he holds the staff… As long as that staff remains in the hands of the Wise King of Wisdom… the Waves will no longer be something to fear.”
Lovey-dovey talk? Is this lovey-dovey talk?
“The Queen is still in love with Trash’s brave figure. If anything happens, we just have to take care of it ourselves, right?”
“So, where is that king?”
“Trash has gone to visit the siblings. He treasures them deeply.”
“If you asks the Hakuko’s younger sister, you can pretty much get him to follow any order. And as for the pig… is he keeping an eye on her?”
Surely, he’s getting distracted by the younger sister.
“Yes, even this morning, he went to visit the ruined pig and called out to her.”

Oh? My guess was wrong. Well, that’s fine. Anyway, regarding the current situation in Melromarc and the surrounding nations, it seems Trash has been handling things quite skillfully. Even in the first world, Father had trusted his abilities, and it looks like that trust wasn’t misplaced. And so, the Three Heroes Church was wiped out as a heretical sect from Melromarc. After that… today, we continue working on the village’s development. With the four heroes working together, there’s nothing we can’t accomplish. Lately, we’ve been focusing on training the village’s slaves and raising the Filolials. Watching the number of Filolials gradually increase is soothing. Even the monsters brought by the village’s physician are being raised here. They seem to be growing quite freely. Speaking of which, I’ve noticed that the neighboring town is being rebuilt faster than it was in the first world. Well, in the first world, it took a long time before Father started the development. Since we acted before people gave up hope, they’re returning to the town earlier this time—or so Father said. It’s quite memorable how Fiancée is busily moving between our village and the neighboring town. Actually, she’s either playing with Sakura, assisting Father and the others with their work, or helping Éclair in the neighboring town. She seems much busier than in the first world.
“Ahaha—Rifana! Raphtalia!”

Kou is joyfully playing tag with big sister and their friends. Lately, big sister has finally stopped forcing that fake smile. Even the night crying seems to have lessened. She’s been carrying a lot of trauma. Thanks to Father and the others’ dedicated care, the village’s slaves have started to walk toward a brighter future. Seeing the many more slaves than before finding hope gives me a sense of accomplishment.
